title: Use Tailwind's responsive prefixes deliberately
guideline: Design mobile-first; add sm:/md:/lg: overrides only where the layout truly changes

title: Stick to Tailwind's spacing scale
guideline: Use the default spacing scale (4px increments) instead of arbitrary values like [17px]

title: Style focus states explicitly
guideline: Use focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 on interactive elements

title: Use the class-based dark mode strategy for user toggles
guideline: Set darkMode: 'class' in config and toggle a class on <html> for a user-controlled switch

title: Keep the generated CSS small
guideline: Ensure content globs cover all template files so unused utilities are purged in production

title: Extract repeated utility clusters into components
guideline: When the same long className string repeats 3+ times, extract a component/partial, not @apply everywhere

title: Don't let utility classes replace semantic tags
guideline: Apply utilities to semantic elements (button, nav, main), not generic divs

title: Reset and restyle native form controls consistently
guideline: Use @tailwindcss/forms as a base, then layer custom focus/border styles

title: Keep a consistent content container width
guideline: Use one max-w-6xl/7xl container class across pages, not mixed widths

title: Avoid excessive arbitrary value usage
guideline: Prefer scale tokens (text-lg, p-4) over arbitrary values like text-[17.3px] unless truly necessary
